references.text: The spies returned to Kadesh-Barnea with their report about the land
The people rebelled and refused to enter the land that the Lord had given them
Joshua and Caleb warned the people not to rebel against the Lord
The Lord declared that those who did not trust in him would not see the promised land
The Lord rebukes their lack of faith and obedience
Moses recounts the command to go up and take possession of the land from Kadesh-Barnea
Moses describes how the people were disobedient and grumbled against the Lord
The psalmist remembers that the people despised the beautiful land and did not believe the Lord's word
Hebrews refers to this generation as those who rebelled and could not enter because of unbelief
Hebrews warns against unbelief by pointing to those who were not allowed to share in rest
